description: customers: stores customer accounts. Columns: id (PK), name, email, state, signup_date.
orders: one row per customer order. Columns: id (PK), customer_id (FK -> customers.id), status (one of: pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled), total, created_at.
products: product catalog. Columns: id (PK), name, category, price.
order_items: line items linking orders to products. Columns: id (PK), order_id (FK -> orders.id), product_id (FK -> products.id), quantity, unit_price.
reviews: customer product reviews. Columns: id (PK), product_id (FK -> products.id), customer_id (FK -> customers.id), rating (1-5), comment, created_at.
